Method of Attack: Fake cryptocurrency mining apps that pretend to mine unminable cryptocurrencies (Ripple XRP, Cardano ADA, Tether) but only display advertisements
Adware behavior, cryptojacking, stealing coins from user's wallets
Indicators of Compromise: Apps claiming to mine Ripple (XRP), Cardano (ADA), and Tether cryptocurrencies
Fake mining hash rates that are random and not actual mining
Error message on withdrawal: 'Error! Check your wallet address'
Apps displaying interstitial advertisements to generate revenue
